periods.summary: Ascaride heals Ikki and other wounded soldiers after Caldia with Orichalcos and becomes one of Vermillion's strongest available representatives. She drives the group to Edelberg, explains Rule of Graces when Edelweiss asks them to swear, and watches Stella's trial with Tatara. When Tatara's advice and Stella's safety strain the contract, Alice considers knocking Stella out to satisfy Nene's backup plan but generally respects the oath. During the fifth night she tells Stella and Tatara her history with Or-Gaule: as Alice Galle she lived in a loved family until her brother's tenth birthday became the Bloody Cross massacre, after which he used her body against police and fled. Her life since then has been devoted to atonement and ending his violence.

key_events.summary: Included among the League members allowed to join Vermillion's roster.
Explains Rule of Graces and swears not to help Stella.
Tells Stella and Tatara the origin of Or-Gaule and her reason to fight.
